subject: Copywriting
title: The Offer: Make It Irresistible
description: A quick win: understand The Offer: Make It Irresistible.

hook.text: Claude Hopkins said: 'The right offer should be so compelling that only a fool would refuse.' That's the standard.

buildup.text: The offer combines price, bonuses, guarantees, and urgency into one package. Each element amplifies the others.

discovery.text: Bonuses can triple response rates. Adding a free report worth $49 to a $97 product makes the deal feel like theft.

twist.text: The offer can save bad copy, but great copy can't save a bad offer. Product-market fit matters more than persuasion.

climax.text: The best offers provide asymmetric value: $97 for something that delivers $1,000 in benefits.

punchline.text: Only a fool would refuse. That's the offer you need to build.

quiz.question: What can bonuses do to response rates?
